title: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1973-02-15
source: Recording Info: SBD MR > R (Bob Menke) > R (Pat Lee); Transfer Info: Technics 1506 w/Lamb Labs Dolby decoder > WAV (24bit/96k) > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC; Mastered By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with decent but not pristine sound, capturing a show that still gets fans excited.
ai_review.review: The two reviewers are clearly thrilled by the performance – one even declares the show still “gets me off.” The recording is a sound‑board source and while it isn’t hailed as top‑tier (it’s noted as not sounding as nice as another well‑known tape), it is still considered good enough to enjoy the music.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave high marks (4–5 stars) and praised the show’s excitement; recording quality is described as adequate but not exceptional, leading to a combined rating around 4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: One reviewer notes this copy isn’t as nice‑sounding as the 4/13/13 recording, implying decent but not top‑tier clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Enthusiastic overall; no specific comments on set structure.
